cpmplus.w4exportfix.menu.orphans.desc: Keyframes of parts that were deleted: connect them to a part again, delete them or leave them
cpmplus.w4exportfix.orphan.title: Loose animations
cpmplus.w4exportfix.orphan.none: No loose animations: every keyframe belongs to a part that exists.
cpmplus.w4exportfix.orphan.warn: The part '%s' does not exist anymore: %s keyframes in %s animation(s) will not go to the game.
cpmplus.w4exportfix.orphan.ifIgnored: That movement is missing in game. Reconnect the keys to a part, or delete them.
cpmplus.w4exportfix.orphan.fixPreview: Reconnect... (choose the part that should get these keys)
cpmplus.w4exportfix.orphan.note: Keyframes are relative to the part's rest pose. If the new part is on the other side, use 'Mirror movement' afterwards. Nothing is mirrored automatically; if the new part has a different pivot or rotation, the movement changes.
cpmplus.w4exportfix.orphan.modeMerge: Merge (on a clash its own key stays)
cpmplus.w4exportfix.orphan.needTarget: Choose the part to connect to (or pick 'Leave').
cpmplus.w4exportfix.orphan.collision: Two old parts go into the same part in the same animation. Choose 'Merge' for them, or different parts.
cpmplus.w4exportfix.orphan.footer: Will reconnect %s part(s) (%s keys), delete %s (%s keys), leave %s.
cpmplus.w4exportfix.orphan.summary: Reconnected %s part(s) (%s keys), deleted %s (%s keys), left %s.
cpmplus.w4exportfix.orphan.discarded: %s key(s) were dropped because the part already had a key at that time.
cpmplus.w4exportfix.parts.rootCreated: + %s created (with the normal Minecraft part, so the game looks the same).
